item.title: Many men lose their Y chromosomes as they age. It may shorten their lives.
item.description: A researcher explores why men lose their Y chromosomes in cells as they age and the health implications associated with this loss.

item.title: Hidden beauty of Zimbabwe's 2.5 billion-year-old 'geological marvel' revealed in striking astronaut photo — Earth from space
item.description: A 2010 astronaut photo shows off the astonishing scale of the Great Dyke of Zimbabwe, which stretches over 340 miles (550 kilometers). The lengthy structure, which is not actually a dike, is full of extremely valuable minerals that fuel a massive mining industry.

item.title: Vanishing lakes in Tibet may have triggered earthquakes by awakening faults in Earth's crust
item.description: Shrinking lakes in Tibet likely woke up long-dormant tectonic faults, a new study finds. The findings strengthen the link between climate change and earthquakes

item.title: Renpho Morphoscan Nova smart scale review: Deep-dive body analysis
item.description: The Renpho Morphoscan Nova goes above and beyond what typical smart scales can do, but is it worth the steep price?

item.title: Mineral sunscreen leaves an annoying white cast on skin — this new formula could change that
item.description: Scientists have developed a new approach to formulating mineral sunscreen that could prevent it from leaving a white cast on the skin.

item.title: Hidden slippery clay on seafloor may have worsened devastating 2011 tsunami in Japan
item.description: A thick layer of slippery clay on the ocean floor may have formed the weak spot that enabled a magnitude 9.1 quake to make such a devastating tsunami.

item.title: Our adorable, noodle-like ancestor had 4 eyes, half-a-billion-year-old fossils reveal
item.description: The earliest recorded vertebrates had four eyes to escape predators in the ancient Cambrian ocean, according to half-a-billion-year-old fossils from China that shed light on our evolutionary origins.

item.title: Sleep deprivation harms the gut via the vagus nerve, early study reveals
item.description: New research reveals that sleep deprivation sends aberrant signals through the vagus nerve, triggering a serotonin surge that can kill gut stem cells.

item.title: Humanoid robots show off creepily impressive kung-fu moves during Lunar New Year festival in China
item.description: Improvements to the AI that powers Unitree's H2 and G1 humanoid robots, alongside mechanical upgrades, have resulted in a dazzling kung-fu demonstration.

item.title: 5,500 years ago, a teenage girl was buried with her father's bones on her chest, new DNA study reveals
item.description: A novel DNA analysis of skeletons excavated from a Neolithic hunter-gatherer cemetery in Sweden has revealed surprising family relationships.
